Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

ticket — a paper that lets you travel. Example: I buy a ticket to London.
price — how much something costs. Example: The price is twenty euros.
time — the hour of the day. Example: What time does the train leave?
leave — to go away from a place. Example: The train leaves at nine.
arrive — to reach a place. Example: It arrives at eleven.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• A ticket to ..., please.
• What time does it leave?
• It arrives at ...
• How much is the ticket?
• Single or return?
